name: Brick Index Computation
aliases: Index Table Lookup for 3D Array Addressing
definition: A technique to compute the linear index of a 3D voxel $(x, y, z)$ in a bricked dataset by precomputing and storing partial index components in lookup tables, avoiding expensive integer division and modulus operations during runtime.
summary: Brick Index Computation maps 3D voxel coordinates to linear indices using precomputed lookup tables, avoiding expensive division operations and branch prediction penalties.
